howto.title: How to Play
howto.step1: Explore the darkness. At first you only see around your feet, but your eyes adapt over time.
howto.step2: Press E to light torches — they light the area forever. Activate teleports to travel instantly.
howto.step3: Find the key hidden in each area, open the central escape room's door and reach the exit!
